items.source:
Create a new PassThroughFilterChain that delegates to the given Filter,
calling it with the given FilterChain.
items.translation: 创建一个委托给给定 Filter 的新 PassThroughFilterChain，并使用给定的 FilterChain 调用它。

items.source: Create a new PassThroughFilterChain that delegates to the given Servlet.
items.translation: 创建一个委托给给定 Servlet 的新 PassThroughFilterChain。

items.source: Pass the call on to the Filter/Servlet.
nextFilterChain - the FilterChain to use for that next Filter
items.translation: nextFilterChain - 用于下一个 Filter 的 FilterChain

items.source: Implementation of the FilterChain interface which simply passes the call through to a given Filter/FilterChain combination (indicating the next Filter in the chain along with the FilterChain that it is supposed to work on) or to a given Servlet (indicating the end of the chain).
items.translation: 实现 `FilterChain` 接口，该接口简单地将调用传递给给定的 Filter/FilterChain 组合（指示链中的下一个 Filter 及其应工作的 FilterChain），或传递给给定的 Servlet（指示链的结束）。
